M docs/LINKEDIN_POST.md
---
diff --git a/docs/LINKEDIN_POST.md b/docs/LINKEDIN_POST.md
index 02b0332..b731577 100644
--- a/docs/LINKEDIN_POST.md
+++ b/docs/LINKEDIN_POST.md
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 # LinkedIn Post: Storm Fund at Sheridan Datathon 2026
 
-This past weekend I took part in the Sheridan Datathon, sponsored by Tangerine and IBM, and won the Best Use of Solana award.
+This past weekend I took part in the Sheridan Datathon, sponsored by Tangerine and IBM, and won an award for the Best Use of Solana.
 
 I built Storm Fund, a financial resilience engine visualized as a weather forecast. It turns an anonymized bank dataset (4,500 accounts, 1.06 million transactions from Tangerine) into financial weather anyone can read at a glance. Simulate a shock (job loss with EI at 55 percent, bills up 15 percent, a furnace repair) and the forecast changes live, showing your buffer in an emergency. It then builds an emergency fund plan to prepare for a rainy day.
 
@@ -8,8 +8,6 @@ Solana is a fast, low cost blockchain that powers many payments and finance apps
 
 It was fun working with financial data and blockchain platforms despite coming from a mechanical engineering background, and I'd love to continue experimenting with more blockchain applications. It would be cool to see if behavioural or credit scores could be attested on chain and influence credit lines. If you're working in this space, I'd love to connect!
 
-A big thank you to Tangerine for sponsoring the Resilience Rewired track and for providing the real anonymized dataset behind this project.
-
 Check out Storm Fund: https://github.com/ajeet-krish/stormfund
 
 (Attach prize picture)
